summary: Executed backend+frontend verification for requested scope: organizations visibility, login organizations, expenses categories, expenses-analysis classification, rules engine simulation UI/API, fail-safe journal behavior, audit before/after snapshots, and setup EXE download integrity.

critical.issue: Fail-Safe status code mismatch: unbalanced journal create returns 400 instead of required 422.
Fail-Safe status code mismatch: unbalanced journal update returns 400 instead of required 422.

integration_issues.flow: Expenses Analysis classification for deduction statements (حج/عمرة، قسط لحوم، لجنة نقابية)
integration_issues.issue: Analysis table classifies keywords correctly but assigns gross_amount to each matched category column instead of deduction amounts, inflating analysis totals.

action_items: Update fail-safe validation path so unbalanced journal create/update returns HTTP 422 consistently (not 400) and keep non-posting behavior.
Adjust ExpensesAnalysis computation to use deduction amounts (or explicit deduction-mapping logic) for جمعية الحج والعمرة/قسط لحوم/لجنة نقابية instead of gross expense amount.
Add deterministic test fixture for conflicting accounting rules, then verify Rule Engine conflict warning UI with an actual conflict scenario.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is monolithic (>700 lines), increasing change-risk for accounting/audit workflows.
Fail-safe rule is implemented in two layers with inconsistent status behavior (normalize_journal_lines raises 400 before save_journal_entry_document 422 guard).
ExpensesAnalysis classifyExpense/categoryAmounts currently ties category allocation to gross_amount, causing duplicated totals when multiple deduction keywords match one expense.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary manual journal entries (ITER51-*) via API and one UI expense record with deduction statements (حج وعمرة/قسط لحوم/لجنة نقابية) for analysis verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Passed checks: /api/organizations/public returns official orgs only; login page shows exactly two organizations; /expenses category dropdown only has مصروفات عمومية + إعانات وفاة; /api/rules-engine/simulate returns simulation_only=true and does not create journal entries; audit logs for PUT chart-account and PUT journal-entry include before_document + after_document; /api/download/setup returns valid MZ EXE with matching /app/dist size. Unresolved: fail-safe status code mismatch (400 vs required 422) and expenses-analysis amount allocation logic inflation.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 Fail-Safe status mismatch: normalize_journal_lines() raises HTTP 400 for imbalance before save_journal_entry_document() 422 guard executes, so manual create/update paths emit 400. Mitigation: centralize imbalance exception mapping to 422 in both create/update flows. RCA-2 Expenses Analysis inflation: categoryAmounts sets each matched category to expense.gross_amount, so one expense with multiple deduction-keyword matches duplicates the full value across columns. Mitigation: map deduction statement amounts per category (or split allocation model) instead of gross total. MOCKED API: Electronic Invoice external ETA submission remains MOCKED/BLOCKED pending official ETA SDK/credentials.
